sources.title: アークザラッドⅡ - JP Any% Glitchless(No File Conversion) RTAレポート(9:58:50)
sources.notes: Independent Japanese full-game chronology corroboration. Its lap sequence independently verifies the mandatory story order from Alfred through Yagos, White House, the split-party arcs, Chimera Research Lab, Greycine/Fores/Brakia/Millmana/Amigue/Barbarad, Palencia Tower/past, north/south towers, Romalia, and Air Castle. Used only for story-order verification, not optional-completion timing.

sources.title: 国/西アルディア
sources.notes: Independent verification that Returnless Forest remains usable as an FBA after White House and that Balzac can be fought after the area is cleared, supporting postponement until after the Grovis/Fate window.

sources.notes: Independent support for the irreversible Choko-event condition: at least one green slime must remain alive for the event to continue.

sources.title: 武器/赤いくつ
sources.notes: Independent support that Red Shoes appears only during the Choko village battle, hidden behind the church.

sources.title: BOSS/アクラ
sources.notes: Independent support for converted Choko awakening at Ruins B71: Choko duels Akura while the other party fights adds, then the group reunites.

sources.title: 武器/光の剣
sources.notes: Independent support for Light Sword synthesis from Earth + Ice + Fire + Wind swords.

sources.title: アークザラッド２データベース — 極限低レベルネックレス取得（暫定版）
sources.notes: PROMOTED INDEPENDENT SET-A COMPONENT for early optional-content placement. The author explicitly states a completion policy of doing every guild job, then records G#01, G#02, G#07, and G#03 after Shu joins and before the closed-bar/Grunag transition to Yagos. Used to corroborate the safe early-job ordering; Set B remains the source for exact disappearance timestamps.

sources.title: Arc The Lad 2 — 手配モンスター
sources.notes: PROMOTED INDEPENDENT SET-A COMPONENT for wanted-monster handling where Chokota is silent. It instructs checking wanted posters on reaching a new town and independently documents first-encounter-only stealing plus Shamus's Grand Knife.

sources.title: アークザラッドⅡ JP Any% Glitchless (No File Conversion) 手順
sources.notes: Direct detailed chronology companion to the recorded RTA report. Used for exact mandatory micro-order/excerpts in the opening and ceremony sections, including Alfred 2, Indigos guild/bar, the post-Leland alley sequence, and the ticket progression.
